description: This file defines a PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy_Proprietary' which extends another class related to HTML purification and tidy module. It provides specific functionality for handling proprietary Tidy attributes, primarily focusing on background attributes and their transformations.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy_Proprietary
classes.description: A class extending the Tidy HTML module to provide proprietary attribute handling, particularly for background and height attributes.

methods.name: makeFixes
methods.description: Creates and returns an array of attribute transformations, specifically for background and height attributes on table and related HTML tags.
